gd: Halò, ciamar a tha thu?
en: Hello, how are you?

gd: Tha gu math, tapadh leat.
en: I'm fine, thank you.

gd: Is mise Iain.
en: I am Iain.

gd: Dè an t-ainm a th' ort?
en: What is your name?

gd: Tha mi a' fuireach ann an Glaschu.
en: I live in Glasgow.

gd: A bheil thu a' tuigsinn?
en: Do you understand?

gd: Chan eil mi a' tuigsinn.
en: I don't understand.

gd: Tha an t-uisge ann an-diugh.
en: It is raining today.

gd: Tha mo mhàthair glè mhath.
en: My mother is very well.

gd: Càite a bheil an taigh-bìdh?
en: Where is the restaurant?

gd: Tha mi sgìth an-dràsta.
en: I am tired right now.

gd: An toil leat cofaidh no tì?
en: Do you like coffee or tea?

gd: Bidh mi a' dol dhan sgoil a-màireach.
en: I will go to school tomorrow.

gd: Bha e brèagha an-dè.
en: It was beautiful yesterday.

gd: Chòrd am film rium gu mòr.
en: I enjoyed the film a lot.

gd: Cia mheud a tha seo a' cosg?
en: How much does this cost?

gd: An do bhruidhinn thu ris an-dè?
en: Did you speak to him yesterday?

gd: Tha an t-acras orm.
en: I am hungry.

gd: Is toil leam a bhith a' coiseachd anns na beanntan.
en: I like walking in the mountains.

gd: Tha i nas fheàrr an-diugh na an-dè.
en: She is better today than yesterday.

gd: Nam biodh an t-airgead agam, shiubhlainn timcheall an t-saoghail.
en: If I had the money, I would travel around the world.

gd: Ged a bha mi sgìth, chaidh mi dhan choinneimh co-dhiù.
en: Although I was tired, I went to the meeting anyway.

gd: Thuirt e gun robh e deiseil airson falbh.
en: He said that he was ready to leave.

gd: Chaidh an taigh ùr a thogail an-uiridh.
en: The new house was built last year.

gd: Tha an rud as cudromaiche dhomh fhìn a bhith a' faighinn deagh fhoghlam.
en: The most important thing for me is getting a good education.

gd: Feumaidh sinn beachdachadh air na builean mus dèan sinn co-dhùnadh.
en: We need to consider the outcomes before we make a decision.

gd: Dh'fhàs a' choimhearsnachd nas làidire thar nam bliadhnaichean.
en: The community grew stronger over the years.

gd: Tha dùbhlain mhòra romhainn a thaobh na h-àrainneachd.
en: We have major challenges ahead regarding the environment.

gd: Air an làimh eile, feumar cuimhneachadh air na buannachdan a thig leis an atharrachadh seo.
en: On the other hand, one must remember the advantages that come with this change.

gd: Thathar ag ràdh gum bi am poileasaidh ùr ga bhuileachadh ron ath-bhliadhna.
en: It is being said that the new policy will be implemented before next year.

gd: A rèir choltais, tha a' mhòr-chuid den phoball an aghaidh an atharrachaidh.
en: Apparently, the majority of the public are against the change.

gd: Aig a' cheann thall, is e an fhianais as làidire a bhios a' toirt buaidh air a' cho-dhùnadh.
en: Ultimately, it's the strongest evidence that will influence the decision.

gd: Tha connspaid mhòr air a bhith ann mun reachdas ùr a thaobh na h-àrainneachd.
en: There has been major controversy over the new environmental legislation.

gd: Gu h-àraidh am measg dhaoine òga, tha teicneòlas air buaidh mhòr a thoirt air mar a tha sinn a' conaltradh.
en: Particularly among young people, technology has had a big effect on how we communicate.

gd: Seo mo theaghlach: mo mhàthair, m' athair, agus mo phiuthar.
en: This is my family: my mother, my father, and my sister.

gd: Tha dà chat agam agus aon chù.
en: I have two cats and one dog.

gd: Càit a bheil an taigh-beag?
en: Where is the toilet?

gd: Tha an leabhar air a' bhòrd.
en: The book is on the table.

gd: Tha mi ag iarraidh cofaidh, mas e do thoil e.
en: I want coffee, please.

gd: Cò às a tha thu? Tha mi à Alba.
en: Where are you from? I'm from Scotland.

gd: Tha an cat a-muigh.
en: The cat is outside.

gd: Tha an cat a' dol a-mach a-nis.
en: The cat is going outside now.

gd: Tha mi nam aonar an-dràsta.
en: I am alone right now.

gd: Seo an t-seanmhair agam.
en: This is my grandmother.

gd: Tha ceathrar anns an teaghlach againn.
en: There are four people in our family.

gd: Tha mi sgìth, ach tha mi toilichte.
en: I am tired, but I am happy.

gd: Oidhche mhath dhut.
en: Good night to you.

gd: Tha an t-sròn agam goirt.
en: My nose is sore.

gd: Bidh mi a' dol dhan bhùth a-màireach.
en: I will go to the shop tomorrow.

gd: Cheannaich mi dà chupa is trì leabhraichean.
en: I bought two cups and three books.

gd: Tha mo bhràthair na thidsear.
en: My brother is a teacher.

gd: An do dh'òl thu do chofaidh fhathast?
en: Have you drunk your coffee yet?

gd: Tha an cù a-staigh, ach tha an cat a-muigh.
en: The dog is inside, but the cat is outside.

gd: Dè is àbhaist dhut a bhith a' dèanamh air an deireadh-sheachdain?
en: What do you usually do at the weekend?

gd: Bu toil leam a dhol a dh'iasgach an-ath-sheachdain.
en: I would like to go fishing next week.

gd: Thuirt mo charaid gu bheil e trang an-dràsta.
en: My friend said that he is busy right now.

gd: Tha mi a' fàs sgìth den obair seo.
en: I am getting tired of this work.

gd: Chòrd an consairt rium gu mòr.
en: I enjoyed the concert a lot.

gd: Bidh sinn a' cluich ball-coise Disathairne.
en: We will play football on Saturday.

gd: An robh thu a-riamh ann an Ameireaga?
en: Have you ever been to America?

gd: Chan urrainn dhomh tighinn a-nochd.
en: I can't come tonight.

gd: Bu chòir dhut sin a dhèanamh a-nis.
en: You should do that now.

gd: Tha an t-acras orm agus tha am pathadh orm cuideachd.
en: I am hungry and I am thirsty too.

gd: Nach eil thu eòlach air an duine sin?
en: Don't you know that man?

gd: Dè a sgrìobhas mi air a' chairt seo?
en: What will I write on this card?

gd: Tha an gàirdean agam goirt às dèidh an gheama.
en: My arm is sore after the game.

gd: Tha dithis bhràithrean agam agus aon phiuthar.
en: I have two brothers and one sister.

gd: Cuin a thèid sinn dhan bhaile-mhòr?
en: When will we go to the city?

gd: Bidh mi a' faireachdainn fo iomagain mus bi deuchainn agam.
en: I feel anxious before I have an exam.

gd: Tha mo nàbaidh na comhairliche air a' bhaile.
en: My neighbour is a councillor on the town council.

gd: Ged a tha an rud seo doirbh, feumaidh sinn a dhèanamh.
en: Although this thing is difficult, we need to do it.

gd: Tha e a' fàs nas duilghe a h-uile bliadhna.
en: It is getting more difficult every year.

gd: Thuirt i gun robh i a' dol a dh'ionnsachadh Gàidhlig.
en: She said that she was going to learn Gaelic.

gd: Bu chòir dhuinn barrachd ùine a chur seachad le ar teaghlaichean.
en: We should spend more time with our families.

gd: Tha a' choimhearsnachd a' fàs nas làidire leis an fhèis seo.
en: The community is growing stronger because of this festival.

gd: Chaidh an obair a chrìochnachadh ron cheann-latha.
en: The work was finished before the deadline.

gd: Tha dùil agam gum bi an aimsir nas fheàrr a-màireach.
en: I expect the weather will be better tomorrow.

gd: Bha e duilich dhomh an t-àite fhàgail às dèidh bliadhna cho math.
en: It was hard for me to leave the place after such a good year.

gd: Tha e cudromach a bhith a' cumail suas le dualchas na dùthcha.
en: It's important to keep up with the country's heritage.

gd: Cha b' urrainn dhomh cadal, mar a bha mi cho fo iomagain.
en: I couldn't sleep, since I was so anxious.

gd: Tha sinn an dòchas gun tig piseach air an t-suidheachadh a dh'aithghearr.
en: We hope the situation will improve soon.

gd: Dh'innis e dhuinn gun robh e a' dol a dh'obair ann am banca ùr.
en: He told us that he was going to work at a new bank.

gd: Tha mòran dhaoine a' fàgail a' bhaile airson obair a lorg.
en: Many people are leaving the town to find work.

gd: Tha i a' faireachdainn nàraichte mu na thuirt i.
en: She feels embarrassed about what she said.

gd: Tha an duilgheadas seo a' toirt buaidh air a' choimhearsnachd gu lèir.
en: This problem is affecting the whole community.

gd: Feumaidh sinn ionnsachadh bho na mearachdan a rinn sinn.
en: We need to learn from the mistakes we made.

gd: Bu mhath leam barrachd ùine a chaitheamh a' leughadh.
en: I would like to spend more time reading.

gd: Tha an t-seann sgoil anns a' bhaile seo fosgailte fhathast.
en: The old school in this town is still open.

gd: Thuirt an neach-stiùiridh gum feumar an ro-innleachd ath-sgrùdadh.
en: The director said that the strategy needs to be reviewed.

gd: Tha a' chomhairle a' beachdachadh air buidseat ùr airson na h-ath-bhliadhna.
en: The council is considering a new budget for next year.

gd: A rèir aithris an-dè, tha cion-cosnaidh air a dhol suas san sgìre seo.
en: According to yesterday's report, unemployment has gone up in this area.

gd: Tha eas-aonta mòr eadar na pàrtaidhean poilitigeach mun chùis seo.
en: There is major disagreement between the political parties on this matter.

gd: B' fheudar don riaghaltas atharrachadh a dhèanamh air a' phoileasaidh.
en: The government was forced to make a change to the policy.

gd: Tha e doirbh a bhith cinnteach dè cho buadhach 's a bhios an ath-leasachadh seo.
en: It's hard to be sure how effective this reform will be.

gd: Tha fianais ag innse dhuinn gu bheil an suidheachadh eaconomach a' dol am feabhas.
en: Evidence tells us that the economic situation is improving.

gd: Tha e riatanach gun tèid an t-ùghdarras seo a chleachdadh gu ciallach.
en: It is essential that this authority is used sensibly.

gd: Chaidh an co-dhùnadh a dhèanamh às aonais deasbad iomchaidh.
en: The decision was made without proper debate.

gd: Tha mòran luchd-poilitigs den bheachd gum bu chòir na riaghailtean atharrachadh.
en: Many politicians are of the opinion that the rules should change.

gd: Tha a' chompanaidh a' cur ro-innleachd ùr an gnìomh an-ath-bhliadhna.
en: The company is putting a new strategy into action next year.

gd: Dh'adhbhraich an t-atharrachadh seo mì-chinnt am measg luchd-obrach.
en: This change caused uncertainty among employees.

gd: Tha e doirbh breithneachadh ceart a dhèanamh gun fhianais iomlan.
en: It's hard to make a fair judgement without complete evidence.

gd: Tha a' mhòr-chuid de na comhairlichean airson leasachadh eaconomach fhaicinn.
en: Most of the councillors want to see economic development.

gd: Tha an suidheachadh a' sìor fhàs nas iom-fhillte.
en: The situation keeps getting more complicated.
